**Round 467:** C passed it (13 rows, 0 bugs, browser verified) and the gate published it as `9ba13ac`.
- I closed C-R466-01, A-R451-REVIEW-L2-ZERO-OFFSET-UNITS, INFO-TL-R451-GLOW-CALC and GATE452-L1-GLOW-REGEX-WHOLE-SOURCE. The INFO id was already in the archive, so it is closed in the decision text and the archive was not edited.
- The last STORE-2b code stage is done. A-R467-REVIEW-L1 went to `deferred_low_polish`.
- The old task is copied to `tasks/round-467.md`.

**Saba's 2026-11-12 feedback:**

| Item | ID | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Store scroll not smooth | SABA-B-15 (Medium) | Rounds 468 (diagnosis) and 469 (fix) |
| More content in Ctrl+K | SABA-Q-CTRLK-CONTENT | Waiting for Saba |

His questions are in `user-review/questions-round-467.md`. The lesson from this issue is merged into L18, and `lessons.md` stays at 60 lines.

**What I measured** (production builds of `9ba13ac`, LeadMagnet popup suppressed, 3 passes per viewport):
- **Home page (`/`):** at HEAD, the median number of slow frames (over 33 ms) per scroll is 9 at 1440 and 8 at 1280. They cluster around scrollY 360–850 and 1850–2000.
- **The scroll library (Lenis) is not the cause.** With it turned off, frames still drop.
- **Also ruled out:** the header blur, the hero's two blurs and the hero video autoplay. None of them helps.
- **The bug is fixable here.** With all content hidden at the same page height, slow frames fall to 0. The cost is painting the visible home content, in a file I haven't found yet.
- **`/free-downloads`, the page Saba named, did not reproduce.** It renders its 3 items and has 0 slow frames in every build. Checking it on his own device is a Tech Lead row, due by RETRO 480.
- **The jump to the top was not a bug.** It is the LeadMagnet popup locking the page while it is open.

**Round 468 task:**
- **A (implementer):** traces the slow frames and tests the remaining suspects in scratch copies, using the probe's CSS-injection mode so each suspect needs no rebuild. A then writes a proposed fix as a diff plus before/after screenshots. The store tree is not touched, and there are no grants.
- **C (verifier):** reproduces HEAD and applies the proposal to its own scratch copy with `patch -p1`. `git apply` would silently do nothing there, because the loop folder is itself a git repository.
- **C's acceptance rows:**
  - slow frames at 2 or fewer at both viewports;
  - scrolling still eased, checked against a mutant with Lenis switched off;
  - `/free-downloads` stays at 0;
  - the sign-in and Studio smoke checks;
  - the lesson exists;
  - the claims match (K1–K22).
- **Rules for the fix:** keep Lenis's current scroll curve (a different feel is only an option for Saba), keep-list items may only be restyled, and `root.tsx` or `app/styles/**` need a root request. Round 469 makes the fix with exact grants.

**Order after this:** the regression round runs at the first planning on or after 2026-11-13 (`regression-last.json` is 2026-11-10). It now includes a home-page scroll check. Then STORE-2c through STORE-5, ARCH-SPLIT, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS and T12-ADVANCED.

The advisor was available and I consulted it three times. Its second and third reviews changed the task: my first draft only allowed edits to the Lenis hook, which the bisect then ruled out.
